id: \rMisty: Don't think I'm just going to let you have this adorable Pokémon without a fight.
en: \rMisty: Don't think I'm just going to let you have this adorable Pokémon without a fight.
it: \rMisty: Non pensare che ti lascerò avere questo adorabile Pokémon senza combattere.

id: \rMisty: It looks like Togepi choose me as its Trainer. Sorry \PN.
en: \rMisty: It looks like Togepi choose me as its Trainer. Sorry \PN.
it: \rMisty: Sembra che Togepi abbia scelto me come sua Allenatrice. Mi dispiace, \PN.

id: \bJames: We're the ones who will get that rare Pokémon.
en: \bJames: We're the ones who will get that rare Pokémon.
it: \bJames: Siamo noi quelli che prenderanno quel Pokémon raro.

id: \bMeowth: That's right! I'll raise it as if it were my own.
en: \bMeowth: That's right! I'll raise it as if it were my own.
it: \bMeowth: Esatto! Lo crescerò come se fosse mio.

id: \rJessie: Will you two shut up and grab it!
en: \rJessie: Will you two shut up and grab it!
it: \rJessie: Volete stare zitti e prenderlo, voi due?!
